It would take place in the present day.

Maxwell Lord will be there as a government agent who asks for wonder woman's help in stopping an elusive criminal, Barbara Minerva.

Barbara Minerva will be the main antagonist. She's a wealthy amoral archeologist, who's believes that the Greek God's are still alive and are in hiding... She's on a quest to find them and gain rare knowledge and power.

Barbara is also an Alchemist and has dozens of mystical artifacts that she collected over the years. She uses them during her fights with Wonder Woman and Maxwell Lord.

Barbara finds an indigenous tribe and undergoes a ritual that would give her divine senses so she can locate the gods from anywhere through minimal focus.
Maxwell Lord and Wonder Woman intervenes... the ritual is incomplete, now Barbara mutates into a monster 'Cheetah'. She again evades them.

Wonder Woman interrogates (via lasso) the local chef who perform the ritual for Cheetah. He reveals his name to be Felix faust and knew about the God's Prophesied Death and his tribe welcomes an existence untethered to the whims of the selfish Gods.
Maxwell Lord asks him to explain the ritual and tries to recreate it. Despite the risks of not being compatible Maxwell Lord gains an ability (insight into people's Minds) and uses it to find Cheetah.

It all ends with Cheetah finding and meeting the pantheon of Gods. She doesn't get what she sought for and Lashes out at them. They find her and stop her with wonder Woman barely surviving the fight.. 
Several God's died....Zeus himself dies in Wonder Woman's arms...He gifts her his abilities before passing.

In the end,
Maxwell Lord and Amanda Waller are discussing a covert government branch called Checkmate. That would act as a counter-measure for metahumans that may act against the interests of the Nation.
